K. Critical Business Rules Currently Implemented
C-1 — Booking price is fully client-controlled
C-2 — Renter can create bookings in any status, including `CONFIRMED`
C-3 — Renter can set any status on their own booking through `PUT /api/bookings/{id}`
C-4 — Any authenticated user can change any order's status
C-5 — Abandoned-cart worker releases stock that the cart never reserved (oversell)
C-6 — Seller settlements credit the buyer for commerce orders and property bookings
C-7 — Same booking or order can be paid more than once
C-8 — Any authenticated user can read any user's or provider's service bookings (PII)
